name: Worked beyond 8 hours a day with no 36 agreement in force

references.title: 法定労働時間 1日8時間 (労働基準法 art.32(2)); beyond it only under a filed 36 agreement (art.36(1); company.facts.overtime_agreement_from/to) or in an emergency (art.33). Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (company.facts.working_time_regime). A worked day is a fact to correct, not to refuse: warn.

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.working_time_regime) ? company.facts.working_time_regime : "STANDARD") == "STANDARD" && day.worked_hours > 8.0 && !(has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_to) && company.facts.overtime_agreement_to >= day.date && (!has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) || company.facts.overtime_agreement_from <= day.date))

name: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force

references.title: 法定労働時間 1週40時間 (労働基準法 art.32(1)), 44 hours for a 特例措置対象事業場 (施行規則 art.25の2; company.facts.weekly_limit_44); the week is the calendar week from company.facts.week_start_day (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号), read on its last day.

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.working_time_regime) ? company.facts.working_time_regime : "STANDARD") == "STANDARD" && int(calendar_distance_days("2023-01-01", day.date)) % 7 == ((has(company.facts.week_start_day) ? int(company.facts.week_start_day) : 0) + 6) % 7 && week.worked_hours > (has(company.facts.weekly_limit_44) && company.facts.weekly_limit_44 == true ? 44.0 : 40.0) && !(has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_to) && company.facts.overtime_agreement_to >= day.date && (!has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) || company.facts.overtime_agreement_from <= day.date))
rules.message: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(1), 36(1)).
rules.description: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force

name: A shift planned beyond 8 ordinary hours: its hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the pay does not price

references.title: 労働基準法 art.32(2) (8 hours a day) and art.37(1) (割増賃金 on every hour beyond it) and art.24 (full payment): overtime is every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours, so ordinary hours planned beyond 8 a day would carry the statutory premium unpriced. Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (company.facts.working_time_regime).

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(company.facts.working_time_regime) ? company.facts.working_time_regime : "STANDARD") == "STANDARD" && day.day_type != "REST" && day.worked && day.scheduled_hours > 8.0
rules.message: The planned shift has more than 8 ordinary hours: the hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the planned day does not price; plan at most 8 ordinary hours and let the rest be overtime (労働基準法 arts.32(2), 37(1)).
rules.description: A shift planned beyond 8 ordinary hours: its hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the pay does not price

name: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8

references.title: 労働基準法 art.34(1): a break of at least 45 minutes where the working time exceeds 6 hours and 1 hour where it exceeds 8, within the working time; the break is the gaps between the day’s clock intervals, and the working time is the time inside them (not the paid hours, which count the planned hours on a day left early). Not for managers (art.41).

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && size(day.intervals) > 0 && day.intervals.all(i, i.end != null) && hours_between(day.intervals, "00:00", "00:00") > 6.0 && (double(calendar_distance_days(day.intervals[0].start.substring(0, 10), day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(0, 10))) * 1440.0 + double(int(day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(11, 13)) * 60 + int(day.intervals[size(day.intervals) - 1].end.substring(14, 16))) - double(int(day.intervals[0].start.substring(11, 13)) * 60 + int(day.intervals[0].start.substring(14, 16)))) / 60.0 - hours_between(day.intervals, "00:00", "00:00") < (hours_between(day.intervals, "00:00", "00:00") > 8.0 ? 1.0 : 0.75) - 0.001
rules.message: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8 (労働基準法 art.34(1)).
rules.description: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8
